resolution.note: ADR-004 moved proposed → accepted with PCS-025 orchestration implemented (packages/workflow-orchestrator/, harness-backed execution, orchestration.* events, /api/orchestration/* routes). Phases 1-3 (review/test, Approval Gateway, parallel waves, token budgets, event-sourced reconcile) are complete; ADR-118 (blueprint) mirrors the acceptance.

finding: PCS-025 identifies ADR-004 as governing architecture while ADR-004 remains proposed.

requiredDecision.accept: Human deciders approve ADR-004 after confirming implementation and verification evidence; update ADR status and decision date through ADR governance.
requiredDecision.reject: Keep ADR-004 proposed or reject it, and revise PCS-025 so it does not present ADR-004 as accepted governing architecture.
requiredDecision.supersede: Create and accept a replacement ADR, then update PCS-025 and ADR-004 supersession metadata.

automationPolicy: Documentation automation must not choose or apply this decision.
